summary: Verified the LLM budget-exceeded scraper fix end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/scraper/run returns HTTP 200 with llm_budget_exceeded=true, discovered=15, created=0, updated=0, and a SINGLE friendly error entry ('...: LLM budget exceeded — top up the Universal Key') proving the short-circuit works (1 error, not 15). 'message' field present and mentions topping up the Universal Key. GET /api/signals/stats identical before/after (total_signals=31 both times) — no partial writes. /api/scraper/status persists last_run with the flag/message and no _id leak. Frontend: clicked run-scraper-btn on the dashboard; a WARNING (amber) sonner toast 'AI budget exceeded — top up to enrich' appeared with the full Universal Key top-up description; NO 'Scrape complete' success toast; zero console/page errors; no crash. 6/6 pytest assertions passed.

minor.issue: Counter semantics: skipped=14 while discovered=15, created=0, updated=0, errors=1. The 14 events were never attempted (loop broke early) yet are reported as 'skipped', which could be read as 'already existed/ignored'. Consider a distinct field (e.g. not_attempted) or leaving skipped=0 when llm_budget_exceeded.

issues: Strip still reads 'LAST SCRAPE: JUST NOW · DISCOVERED 15 · NEW 0 · UPDATED 0' with no budget-exceeded indicator after the toast dismisses, so the original confusion can recur once the transient toast is gone. Consider a persistent amber badge/banner sourced from last_run.llm_budget_exceeded.

action_items: Optional: surface last_run.llm_budget_exceeded persistently in the dashboard status strip (toast is transient).
Optional: fix 'skipped' counter semantics for the short-circuit path.
critical_code_review_comments: ingestion.py budget detection is substring-based on str(e).lower(); it will also match unrelated messages containing '429' (e.g. a title/id containing 429). Prefer matching on the LLM client's structured error type/status code.
The friendly error string is prefixed with the event title, which is fine, but the frontend only uses summary.message — errors[] text is only visible via /api/scraper/runs.
seed_data_creation: None. Scrape run created no signals (budget-exceeded path); one ingestion_runs summary row recorded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Universal Key is still over budget, so the budget-exceeded path remains live and reproducible. Reusable regression test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_llm_budget_shortcircuit.py (will start failing once the key is topped up — then created>0/llm_budget_exceeded=false is expected). Frontend scrape button testid: run-scraper-btn; toasts are sonner ([data-sonner-toast]).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the original '15 new signals but nothing added' confusion was enrich_signal() raising a ChatError per event due to the Emergent Universal Key budget being exhausted; each event was caught individually and the summary still reported discovered=15 with a green success toast. Fix verified: the except block now classifies budget/ratelimit errors, sets llm_budget_exceeded, appends one friendly error, breaks the loop, and the summary carries a top-up message the frontend renders as a warning toast.
